text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So many wonderful older girls were 
scheduled to run in the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Like Mejiro McQueen-san...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer, Ikuno Dictus... Everyone's 
so mature and cool... It takes real 
courage to step into their circle. But 
still!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer gave me courage... I'm 
sure I'll be all right!
